title: Map extraction batch accounting and partial outcomes

identity.source_kind: git archive of exact commit; no Git metadata

findings.invariant: Public claims_extracted is not filed admitted output whenever extract_usage exists.
findings.evidence: Fixture case F_partial_then_replay, observed 2026-09-06T22:02:47Z: failed receipt claims_extracted=2, model.calls=1, live_model_claims=0, extract_batches=1, checkpoint=null. Replay write-pass claims_extracted=0, model.calls=0, live_model_claims=2, checkpoint at event 2.
findings.required_fix: None in this prep lane. Downstream must not treat RunReceipt.claims_extracted as stored claims on failed/partial runs. WritePassResult.claims_extracted is the filed-new-mine counter.

findings.invariant: model.calls counts produce/LLM attempts; claims_extracted counts drafts at a specific seam; the extract cursor is an event boundary.
findings.evidence: Fixture A: 2 events, produce_input_event_count=2, produce_invocations=1, model.calls=1, claims_extracted=2, checkpoint at event 2. B: extracted=1 with unknown_predicate=1 still advances. C empty-ok advances with extracted=0. D/E do not advance.

findings.invariant: claims_rejected mixes whole-call RejectReason and per-draft DroppedDraftReason.
findings.evidence: D_rejected schema_invalid=1 is a model failure; B_one_drop unknown_predicate=1 is a counted drop on an ok call.
